statement: run-waves.py identifies the final wave by comparing the wave label to len(waves); comparing against the last wave label instead preserves one-consolidated-commit-per-run for both consecutive and non-consecutive labellings.
justification: The final-wave decision drives whether the consolidated commit is emitted; an off-by-one on non-consecutive wave labels silently drops the run's only commit (bug-11). Six independent prep probes verify the defect location, the four bug-11 labellings, and non-final deferral, giving enough evidence to clear the 0.85 floor.
